title: Cardano Use Case Study: Bridging DeFi and TradFi

ms.promise:
・Conduct thorough research on potential areas where Traditional Finance (TradFi) and Decentralized Finance (DeFi) could collaborate.
・Develop initial research guidelines, assumptions, hypotheses, and specific areas of investigation within the DeFi-TradFi framework.
・Collect and integrate feedback from developers and the community on the research findings and approach.
ms.criteria:
・Research on multiple DeFi and TradFi concepts.
・Initial Guidelines: Clearly define the research parameters including assumptions, hypotheses, and specific areas of investigation such as lending platforms or asset management.
・Clearly show how feedback influenced the research and improvements.
